$comment: Canonical pillar registry. This file is the ONLY place a pillar is defined.
Backend, frontend and ingestion each consume a generated artefact derived
from this file — run `node scripts/gen-pillars.mjs` after any edit, and
commit the generated files alongside it. `gen-pillars.mjs --check` fails
the build if they have drifted, so the three languages cannot disagree.
A pillar with status "off" has no data source that exists. It is not
rendered, not served, and has no code path that could render it. Turning
one back on means editing this file and writing down where the numbers
weights_rationale: Water & Sanitation is the flagship and by a wide margin the best-sourced pillar (KNBS 2019 census at sub-county resolution plus 17 editions of WASREB IMPACT), so it carries the largest share. Road density and transit accessibility are equally weighted behind it: both derive from the same OSM/GTFS extraction and neither is more defensible than the other. Held pillars carry zero weight — a 2019 figure is shown as context with its vintage attached, not folded into a 2026 score.

pillars.description: Household water source and sanitation type, set against the utility's own service-performance record.
Kilometres of mapped road per square kilometre of sub-county.
Share of residents living within walking distance of a matatu stop.
Share of households using electricity for lighting. The vintage is old and is stated on every reading.

retired.reason: No sub-county source exists. Every candidate is a national score, and spreading a national figure across 17 sub-counties is inventing data.
Kenyan crime statistics are not published at sub-county resolution and reporting rates vary too much between sub-counties for the numbers to be comparable.
Depended on a live project feed that was never delivered. The values shown were derived from seeded fixtures.
No sub-county air-quality or hazard source with a usable vintage. Satellite proxies were considered and rejected as unverifiable at this resolution.
There is no live grid feed. Superseded by electricity_access, which reports a real census figure with its vintage attached.
